plainText:
Tomokazu Seki (Japanese: 関智一 Seki Tomokazu) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Seki was born on September 8, 1972 in , , , and became a voice actor and singer as an adult. His first role in his career was in the 1993 anime ; he has since gone on to voice a number of well-known roles in anime series. Seki joined the during , with his most prominent role being that of Tracey Sketchit, one of 's . He once worked with the , but is now affiliated with Atomic Monkey.
